blocks.x: Did you know that the largest Spirit Halloween store in the United States is located just two hours from New York City? Because there’s Spirit Halloween, and then there’s Spirit Halloween.
The mecca of all spooky locations, this massive 20,000-square-foot store opened as a Spirit Halloween flagship in 2012, located in Egg Harbor Township, New Jersey.
And let’s be clear: this isn’t just your average Rite-Aid-turned-Spirit-Halloween pop-up.
The 2026 Grand Opening
The spooky flagship hosted its highly anticipated seasonal grand opening on Saturday, August 1, 2026.

With a newly introduced digital preregistration capped at 2,000 people, an estimated additional 1,000 fans showed up for general admission. Some die-hard Halloween lovers even traveled across the country for the event!
By 9 am, the line had snaked all the way around Harbor Square Mall despite the summer heat, according to The Inquirer.

Food vendors, music, face-painting, outdoor games, and freebies awaited those who braved the lines. Kids and adults alike turned up in everything from casual shorts and T-shirts to elaborate, blood-soaked character costumes.

Next-Level 2026 Animatronics
This flagship location always debuts Spirit’s most advanced animatronics, and the 2026 lineup introduces major upgrades like “active response technology,” Bluetooth audio, and outdoor-rated builds.
Some life-size animatronics sold out in minutes on opening day. Standouts you can find this year include:
Freddy Fazbear: A highly anticipated life-size animatronic new to Spirit and sold exclusively in-store
Trash Bandit: A radioactive pop-up trash raccoon featuring eerie blacklight effects that make his decay glow in the dark
Michael Myers: The iconic silent stalker returns with head-scanning motion, twisting knife-lift action, and the original 1978 Halloween theme audio
Willow Witch: A mystical sorceress featuring industry-first conversation response technology so she can actually interact with guests
Jeremy Jaws: A diseased wanderer with disturbingly realistic slack-jawed movements

Costumes & Merch Heaven
From bedazzled Michael Myers masks to hilarious dog costumes, visitors to the flagship store have no shortage of decor and costumes to choose from.
With more square footage than any other Spirit in the country, this store packs in the absolute widest selection of costumes, props, and exclusives.
The décor goes way beyond standard jack-o’-lanterns—expect themed bathroom sets, kitchenware, wall art, and life-sized haunted house props to build your own DIY scare zone.

Shutterstock / Retail Photographer
How & When to Visit
Location: 6725 E Black Horse Pike #26, Egg Harbor Township, New Jersey 08234
When: Now through October 31, 2026 | 9 am – 10 pm daily
Getting There From NYC:
By Car: The fastest route is down the Garden State Parkway. It’s about a 120-mile drive and usually takes just over 2 hours depending on traffic

By Public Transit: You can take the NJ Transit bus (Route 319) from Port Authority to Atlantic City, then catch a local bus (like the 507 or 509) into Egg Harbor Township. Expect the trip to take around 3 to 3.5 hours total
By Train: Amtrak and NJ Transit offer trains out of Penn Station to Philadelphia’s 30th Street Station, where you can transfer to the Atlantic City Rail Line to get to nearby Egg Harbor City
Insider Tip: Weekends get packed. For the best experience (and shortest lines at the interactive animatronics zones), plan your road trip for a weekday.
